name: CrownClash
mechanic: A live volume leaderboard - trade the most to hold the crown. 0.07% of each trade to the treasury.
plain: Every trade pays a tiny 0.07% into the treasury and adds that amount to your personal running score. Whoever has traded the most holds the 'crown'. It's a live leaderboard kept entirely onchain - trade more than the current leader to take the top spot.
rules: Every trade pays 0.07% to the treasury and adds that amount to your score.
Whoever has traded the most holds the onchain crown.
The leaderboard lives entirely onchain - out-trade the leader to take it.

fee.note: 0.07% of each swap to the treasury
